name: Prophecy
overview: Prophecy in Scripture reveals God's sovereign plan and foreknowledge, as seen in His promises to bless all the nations through Abraham and his seed, highlighting the certainty of His covenantal blessings (Genesis 12:3; 18:18; 22:18). Prophetic declarations also include warnings and future events, such as Jacob's address to his sons about what will occur in the last days (Genesis 49:1), and God's judgments foretold in vivid terms (Leviticus 26:29). The Spirit of God empowers prophets like Balaam to see and declare God's purposes, demonstrating that prophecy is divinely inspired and authoritative (Numbers 24:2).
